name: supersonic-arena
description: Jeu de foot en voitures a reaction inspire de Rocket League, jouable sur PC dans le navigateur.

scripts.apk: npm run build && cd android && ./gradlew --no-daemon assembleRelease && cp app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk ../SupersonicArena.apk
scripts.exe: npm run build && rm -rf desktop/www && mkdir -p desktop/www/dist && cp index.html style.css desktop/www/ && cp dist/game.js desktop/www/dist/ && cd desktop && GOOS=windows GOARCH=amd64 go build -trimpath -ldflags "-H windowsgui -s -w" -o ../SupersonicArena.exe .
